Before a betrayal, remember what you said to that power.
Do not promise a hold in a province you plan to take.
Punish any power that attacks you.
Forgive a power that apologises and keeps the next promise.
Send few messages.
Be cold. Do not flatter. Do not plead.
When a power keeps a promise, trust that power.
Avoid attacking weak players unless gain.
Always build if safe.
Expand early into neutral centres.
Stab an ally only when the gain wins the game.
